author: Bobby Grayson
description: The usage-limit cutoff cost nothing in the end: resumed builders continued from their worktrees; the integrator merged five branches with only check.sh/Leanactors.lean textual conflicts.
title: Two liveness builders independently proved the same generic lemmas (timers-append group, eraseIdx/findIdx facts) in their own files; git saw no conflict but Lean would have. The integrator hoisted them into SysProps/Fair. Lesson for the protocol: builders should announce generic lemmas in the graph as they add them so siblings reuse instead of re-prove. Also: a resumed run duplicated goals (first-attempt goals imported by sync); link, don't delete
